overrides.sourceText: Sit or lie down in a comfortable position. Place the tip of your tongue against the ridge behind your upper front teeth.

translations.de-de: Setzen oder legen Sie sich in eine bequeme Position. Legen Sie die Zungenspitze an den Gaumenwulst direkt hinter den oberen Schneidezähnen.

overrides.sourceText: Close your mouth and inhale quietly through your nose for a mental count of 4.

overrides.sourceText: Hold your breath for a count of 7. Keep your body relaxed.
